Understand the rules that keep our marketplace fair and secure.
These terms govern how you book services, communicate with professionals, and use SkillLink.

1. Acceptance of terms
By using SkillLink you agree to comply with our service standards, safety rules, and payment policies.

2. Service conduct
We expect all users to act professionally, arrive on time, and resolve disputes respectfully.

3. Payments and fees
All transactions must be completed through the SkillLink platform; processing fees may apply.

4. Cancellations
Late cancellations or no-shows may result in penalties or temporary account suspension.

5. Updates
SkillLink may update these terms to comply with regulations and improve the service. We will notify you of significant changes.
Learn how we collect, protect, and use your information responsibly.
We are committed to safeguarding your data and being transparent about how it is used.

1. Data we collect
We collect account details, booking history, and support interactions to provide reliable services.

2. How we use your data
Your information helps us match you with professionals, improve safety, and offer personalised experiences.

3. Sharing and security
We never sell personal data. Information is shared only with trusted partners under strict confidentiality.

4. Your choices
You can update your profile, request data exports, or contact us to delete your account at any time.

5. Contact us
Reach the SkillLink privacy team at privacy@skilllink.lk for any questions or requests.
